summary.text: Todd Gardenhire is a Republican state senator from Chattanooga representing Tennessee Senate District 10 (Bledsoe, Hamilton, Marion and Sequatchie Counties), a member of the 108th through 114th General Assemblies. He chairs the Senate Judiciary Committee and the Fiscal Review Committee.

paragraphs.text: Gardenhire was born on May 7, 1948, and earned a B.S. in business administration from the University of Tennessee at Chattanooga in 1972.
He is retired after 43 years in the financial industry and is married to Sylvia; they have four children and five grandchildren.

He served as a presidential appointee to the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corporation Advisory Committee from 2006 to 2010 and was named chair of the ERISA Advisory Council for the 2005 session by the U.S. Secretary of Labor.
He has served on the board of Awakening, Inc. since 1994.
